label: S1 reached (D2), early in episode; habituates to repeated S1
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the state input is S1 (100% of mass at in_state==1; never at D1, GO, or S2). Among S1 D2 steps it is restricted to the first part of the episode: rate ~16% of all steps in trials 0-9, falling steadily to 0 after trial ~55, so (D2 & S1 & ep_trial<45) gives dev F1 0.77, mass recall 0.97. Magnitude is largest on an S1 visit that follows non-S1 trials (S2 visits) or an unrewarded S1 visit (top-quartile coverage 0.97 for prev_state!=S1), and decays over runs of consecutive rewarded S1 visits (e.g. 0.55, 0.39, 0.23, 0.16, 0.10) -- a novelty/habituation-like S1 signal. Adding the habituation condition (prev state not S1, or prev unrewarded, or two-back not S1) gives only ~+0.01 F1, so the simpler predicate is recorded. Remaining false positives are mostly long rewarded S1 runs where it has habituated to zero, and late-episode S1 visits. Uses only observed variables (state input at D2, trial index).
